demoBlurb.en: Menu, opening hours, map, and tap-to-call. Shows up properly on Google.
demoBlurb.ga: Biachlár, uaireanta oscailte, léarscáil agus glao le cnag. Le feiceáil i gceart ar Google.

tagline.en: Coffee, chowder and cake by the turf fire. Walkers, cyclists and dogs all welcome.
tagline.ga: Caife, seabhdar agus cáca cois tine mhóna. Fáilte roimh shiúlóirí, rothaithe agus madraí.

en: A small family café with a big turf fire. Everything is baked in our own kitchen each morning, and the fish comes off the boats in Rossaveal.
ga: Caife beag teaghlaigh le tine mhóna mhór. Bácáiltear gach rud inár gcistin féin gach maidin, agus tagann an t-iasc ó na báid i Ros an Mhíl.

desc.en: Local sausages, rashers, egg, pudding, brown bread
desc.ga: Ispíní áitiúla, slisíní, ubh, putóg, arán donn

desc.en: With honey, berries and a drop of cream
desc.ga: Le mil, caora agus braon uachtair

menuNote.en: Please tell us about any allergies when you order.
menuNote.ga: Inis dúinn faoi aon ailléirgí nuair a ordaíonn tú.

text.en: The chowder alone is worth the drive.
text.ga: Is fiú an turas ar an seabhdar amháin.

text.en: Soaked from the Greenway and they sat us by the fire. Lovely people.
text.ga: Fliuch báite ón nGlasbhealach agus chuir siad cois tine sinn. Daoine galánta.
